overall_reason: Carefully built and specific in its captions (partial-week note, refresh source, worded deltas), but the screen is the stock revenue-dashboard skeleton with the sample-data cast, so a 'SaaS revenue dashboard' prompt would land on nearly this layout.

findings.evidence: Order is sidebar nav + search/avatar bar > hero KPI with bar chart > KPI stack (NRR, churn, pipeline) > donut 'Revenue by plan' > ranked bars 'Largest accounts' > sparklines 'Expansion by region' > sortable table > activity feed. Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-MIRROR: every block is the stock admin-dashboard kit and would be generated for any B2B revenue console.
findings.before: Bento of KPI cards, donut, ranking, sparklines, table, feed
findings.after: Pick the one question this console answers first (e.g. which renewals are at risk this month) and let that block lead; demote or drop panels that do not serve it
findings.why: A dashboard that shows every chart type once is a decorative dashboard, not an answer.

findings.where: hero card 'NET RECURRING REVENUE', bar chart
findings.evidence: Caption says 'Week 27 is the current, partial week.' yet the orange week-27 bar is the tallest of seven; a partial week out-earning every full week is implausible and the chart has no y-axis values to check it. Failed T-THREE-LINE (not falsifiable from the chart).
findings.before: Unlabelled 7-bar chart, partial week tallest and highlighted orange
findings.after: Show week-27 as a hatched or outlined partial bar at its real (lower) value with axis ticks; [DATA NEEDED: weekly NRR values]
findings.why: Placeholder data that contradicts its own caption reads as invented.

findings.evidence: A 4-segment donut (Enterprise 46%, Growth 31%, Team 15%, Starter 8%) with a separate legend list repeating the numbers; T-DELETION: removing the donut loses nothing the list does not already say.
findings.after: One stacked horizontal bar labelled in place, or just the four-row list
findings.why: Part-to-whole with four parts reads faster as a labelled bar; the donut is decoration.

findings.evidence: Account cast is the sample-data set ('Northwind Logistics', 'Kestrel Financial', 'Helios Biotech', 'Meridian Health Network'); sweep flagged Northwind/Kestrel. All metrics are illustrative with no source beyond the footer line.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: real or clearly labelled demo accounts], or mark the screen 'Demo data'
findings.why: The default cast is the clearest tell that nobody supplied content.

findings.where: hero bar chart vs donut legend
findings.evidence: Orange #e8710a-ish means 'current partial week' in the bar chart and 'Growth plan' in the donut and 'Europe' in sparklines; blue means past weeks, Enterprise and North America. One palette is reused with three meanings on one screen.
findings.before: Same 4 series colours reused across unrelated charts
findings.after: Reserve orange for a single meaning (e.g. 'current/partial'); use neutral grey for past weeks
findings.why: Colour that changes meaning card to card makes readers re-learn every chart.

findings.where: every card heading: 'NET RECURRING REVENUE', 'GROSS CHURN', 'LARGEST ACCOUNTS', 'ACTIVITY'
findings.evidence: All card titles are 12px tracked uppercase labels; T-LABEL-TRANSFORM: they read as well in sentence case ('Net recurring revenue'), and the one sentence-case title ('Accounts at renewal') is the only one that reads as a heading.
findings.before: text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing on all card titles
findings.after: Sentence-case card titles at 14px semibold, matching 'Accounts at renewal'
findings.why: Caps-tracked labels on every card are costume, not hierarchy.

strengths: Captions carry real meaning: 'Recurring revenue only. Usage and one-off invoices are billed separately.', 'Figures refresh hourly. Last run 09:00 UTC from the revenue warehouse.', '+0.3 pts two enterprise accounts downgraded.' Keep this worded-qualifier pattern.
Restrained palette, tabular figures, a real sortable table with status text in badges, and a working dark-mode toggle.
not_investigated: Sort behaviour of table headers and tab switching (no live interaction).
Footer credit line 'Built with ux-ui-agent-skills ... Every pixel here is token-driven and gate-verified' treated as a showcase credit, not product copy.
